selection: First qualifying matched-repeat triple in experiment order for each task. Require student success, BF16 success, QAD failure, and student episode time lower than BF16. Post-hoc examples, not aggregate speed or reliability claims.
timing: Same perf_counter boundaries: first observation after reset and warmup through evaluator completion or 30-action cap; includes screenshot acquisition, generation, browser actions and waits. Excludes model loading, reset, warmup and recording export.
limitations: All three arms use one physical A100 per experiment, sequentially. Other jobs remain active.
Identical full browser state is not certified; tasks and reset protocol match.
QAD is an earlier three-update Qwen3-VL baseline; BF16 and student are brownie lineage. Not a matched-training ablation.
Selected timing advantage does not establish an advantage averaged over repeats or retries.
CUDA Graphs are enabled for every model. Prefix caching and low-temperature sampling, where used, apply to all models in that experiment.
Prompts and task descriptions are unchanged; no teacher guidance.
